text.zh-CN:
类风湿关节炎是免疫系统误伤关节的长期疾病，常有疼痛、肿胀和僵硬。

- 手、腕和足部常受影响，也可能涉及多个关节。
- 症状可反复加重，称为发作或活动期。
- 疲劳等全身表现也可能出现，不能简单等同于年老磨损。
text.en:
Rheumatoid arthritis is a long-term immune disease causing painful, swollen and stiff joints.

- Hands, wrists and feet are often affected.
- Symptoms can worsen in episodes called flares.
- Fatigue and other systemic effects distinguish it from simple wear-related pain.

text.zh-CN:
免疫异常的触发原因尚未完全明确。

- 原本抵抗感染的免疫系统误把关节内衬作为攻击目标。
- 持续炎症可影响软骨、骨和周围组织。
- 家族因素、女性和吸烟与风险有关，但不能据此确定个人病因。
text.en:
The exact immune trigger is uncertain.

- Defences normally fighting infection attack joint lining.
- Ongoing inflammation can damage cartilage, bone and nearby tissues.
- Family history, female sex and smoking affect risk without identifying one person's cause.

text.zh-CN:
新的急性问题需要及时评估。

- 单个关节突然很热、很肿并伴发热，要排除感染，不只当作普通发作。
- 使用影响免疫的药时出现明显感染症状，应尽快联系治疗团队。
- 新发胸痛、呼吸困难或视力改变，需要及时就医评估。
text.en:
New acute problems require review.

- A suddenly hot swollen joint with fever needs infection excluded.
- Significant infection symptoms during immune-affecting treatment need prompt team contact.
- New chest pain, breathlessness or visual change requires medical assessment.

text.zh-CN:
尽早诊断有助保护关节。

- 持续关节肿胀、疼痛和僵硬，应预约评估。
- 已确诊者活动能力下降或发作频繁，要提前复诊调整。
- 不要只等止痛药无效才寻求控制疾病的治疗。
text.en:
Early diagnosis helps protect joints.

- Persistent swelling, pain and stiffness warrants assessment.
- More flares or reduced function after diagnosis needs earlier review.
- Do not wait until painkillers fail before discussing disease control.

text.zh-CN:
不能用一项血液指标决定有或没有病。

- 医生检查肿胀关节、活动范围和症状分布。
- 炎症指标、类风湿因子及抗CCP抗体提供线索，阴性也不能单独排除。
- 影像帮助查看炎症和损伤，功能评估看穿衣、走路等实际能力。
text.en:
No single blood marker establishes or excludes the condition.

- Examination assesses swelling, movement and symptom pattern.
- Inflammatory markers and antibodies provide clues; negative results do not rule it out alone.
- Imaging and daily-function assessment add different information.

text.zh-CN:
多种疾病也可使关节疼痛僵硬。

- 骨关节炎、痛风及其他炎症性关节病需要结合病程区分。
- 感染可造成急性肿痛，尤其伴发热时必须考虑。
- 关节分布、僵硬持续时间及查体比单看一个抗体结果更全面。
text.en:
Several conditions cause painful stiff joints.

- Osteoarthritis, gout and other inflammatory diseases have overlapping features.
- Infection is important in an acutely swollen joint with fever.
- History and examination provide context that an antibody result alone cannot.

text.zh-CN:
治疗目标包括抑制炎症和减少损伤。

- 改善病情抗风湿药调节疾病过程，不只是短期止痛。
- 生物制剂等可用于合适患者，方案需按疗效和风险调整。
- 物理及作业治疗帮助保持力量和日常活动，严重结构损伤时可能考虑手术。
text.en:
Treatment suppresses inflammation and limits damage.

- Disease-modifying drugs affect progression rather than only pain.
- Biological and other treatments are selected by response and risk.
- Physiotherapy and occupational therapy support function; structural damage may require surgery.

text.zh-CN:
不同药物需要不同监测。

- 甲氨蝶呤等可能影响血细胞或肝脏，需要定期化验。
- 生物制剂会增加某些感染风险，治疗前后的感染评估很重要。
- 消炎止痛药不能阻止关节损伤，且可能导致胃出血；激素通常短期使用，长期可能影响骨骼等。
text.en:
Different drugs require different monitoring.

- Methotrexate can affect blood cells and liver, requiring tests.
- Biological treatments increase certain infection risks and need infection assessment.
- Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) do not prevent joint damage and can cause stomach bleeding. Steroids are often short-term treatments because prolonged use can harm bones and other tissues.

text.zh-CN:
饮食作为支持，不能替代控制炎症。

- 均衡饮食可包含蔬果、豆类、全谷及合适脂肪来源。
- 特定食物与症状的关系因人而异，广泛禁食可能损害营养。
- 叶酸或钙等补充有时用于降低特定药物风险，应按治疗方案安排。
text.en:
Diet supports but does not replace inflammation control.

- Use balanced meals with vegetables, pulses, grains and suitable fats.
- Broad exclusions may impair nutrition; personal food effects vary.
- Selected supplements may reduce medicine-related risks when prescribed as part of care.

text.zh-CN:
护理重在保护关节同时维持活动。

- 活动与休息交替，不因怕痛长期完全不动。
- 手部训练、合适鞋垫或开瓶工具可帮助完成日常任务。
- 记录肿胀、僵硬、疲劳及用药反应，带到复诊讨论。
text.en:
Balance joint protection with movement.

- Alternate tasks and breaks rather than prolonged complete inactivity.
- Hand exercises, suitable supports and tools can ease daily tasks.
- Track swelling, stiffness, fatigue and treatment response.

text.zh-CN:
人生阶段和基础病会改变用药选择。

- 备孕、怀孕或哺乳计划要提前告知风湿科。
- 经常感染或有肝肾问题者，方案及化验安排需个体化。
- 老年或行动受限者应同时评估跌倒、辅助器具与照护需求。
text.en:
Life stage and other conditions affect care.

- Tell your rheumatology team in advance if planning pregnancy, pregnant or planning to breastfeed.
- Recurrent infections or liver or kidney problems require an individual treatment and blood-test schedule.
- Older or less mobile people may need fall, equipment and care assessments.

text.zh-CN:
随访关注疾病活动度与功能。

- 早期适当治疗可让部分人长时间没有明显发作。
- 控制疾病的药可能需一段时间起效，不能凭几天感受判定无效。
- 缓解不等于自行停药安全，调整应结合检查和个人风险。
text.en:
Follow-up tracks disease activity and function.

- Early effective treatment can produce long periods between flares.
- Disease-modifying medicines may take time to work; a few days of symptoms are not enough to conclude they have failed.
- Remission does not make unsupervised stopping safe; changes need test results and individual risks to be considered.

text.zh-CN:
影响可能超出关节。

- 持续炎症可能导致关节损伤和日常功能受限。
- 腕部神经受压可造成手麻等症状。
- 肺、心脏和眼部也可能受累，心脑血管风险需一并管理。
text.en:
Effects can extend beyond joints.

- Ongoing inflammation can cause damage and disability.
- Pressure on wrist nerves can cause hand symptoms.
- Lungs, heart and eyes may be involved, alongside cardiovascular risk.

text.zh-CN:
目前不能保证预防发病或复发。

- 不吸烟有助降低可改变的风险。
- 按计划治疗和监测，可减少持续炎症造成的损伤。
- 出现感染或新器官症状及时联系团队，不靠单纯增加止痛药处理。
text.en:
There is no guaranteed prevention of disease or flares.

- Avoid smoking to address a modifiable risk.
- Planned treatment and monitoring reduce ongoing inflammatory damage.
- New infection or organ symptoms requires review rather than simply more pain relief.
